text: I am placing a floor/wall on a floor that isnt the bottom and the wall just places on the bottom. it now follows the floor grid im on but the peice just falls through
resolution: After the level fix made placement follow the active floor, a piece placed on an upper floor fell to the bottom: liftBuildingsToTerrain pads a group's lowest piece DOWN to the terrain under its footprint, and an upper-floor piece's base sits ABOVE terrain (negative offset) so it was dropped. Fix: only ever lift a group UP (apply when offset>0), never push it down — a ground building under a painted hill still rises (the offset is keyed on its ground floor, so upper floors ride along), but an upper-floor piece is never dropped to the ground. Committed ad59c4578, bundles clean.
